title: feat: percentage discounts at checkout
reason: Guards a follow-up that must both close the old finding and see a new defect. The since-diff adds the clamp (the thread is fixed) and, in the same lines, a cache keyed by the percentage alone, so a later call returns the first price's result for any other price. The verifier should report the thread fixed and raise the cache defect.

expected.claim: applyDiscount caches its result by the bounded percentage alone, but the result also depends on priceCents. After the first call for a percentage, every later call with another price returns the first price's discounted value, so totals are wrong. The finding must say the cache key leaves out the price; a finding about the clamp or about the cache growing without bound does not match.

title: feat: report state a mock factory shares between tests
reason: Guards the verdict on a finding posted in a review body, which has no thread. The earlier review's high finding sits in mock-capture.mts, and the since-diff touches only report.mts, so the code at the finding's line is unchanged. The verifier should keep it (cite the input finding in sources) and not drop it: dropping a finding whose file the since-diff never touched is the miss seen on no-mistakes#4683.

findings.title: mock capture reads the raw callee, so a wrapped mock gives a false clean report

bodyFindings.title: mock capture reads the raw callee, so a wrapped mock gives a false clean report
bodyFindings.body: `isMockFactoryCall` compares the raw callee name with `mock`, so `hoisted(mock)(...)` has a `CallExpression` callee and is read as not a mock factory. The rule then reports no shared state for the wrapped form the description says callers use.
